{
  "S1_split_unit": {"code": "U", "quote": "", "location": "", "reason": "The paper is an unsupervised signal-processing method (CSR decomposition, adaptive denoising, envelope spectrum). It has no training/test split. The filters are learned from similar subblocks of the same signal being analysed (Sec. III-A, Algorithm 1). Sections III–IV were checked and no train/test division is described, so the split cannot be judged."},
  "S2_validation": {"code": "U", "quote": "", "location": "", "reason": "No validation set is mentioned anywhere. λ is chosen from simulated experiments (Sec. III-D2, p.7), not from a stated validation set. Because there is no train/test framework at all, U was chosen over A."},
  "S3_checkpoint_rule_code": {"code": "N", "quote": "", "location": "", "reason": "No public code was provided (NO_CODE), and the paper gives no repository link."},
  "S4a_text_discloses": {"code": "N", "quote": "", "location": "", "reason": "No model or epoch selection rule is stated. The only related remark is in Sec. III-B3 (p.5), that the number of subproblem iterations 'can be adjusted to obtain the best results'. That refers to ADMM coupling, not to choosing which model is reported. The paper has no checkpoint concept."},
  "S4b_text_matches_code": {"code": "N", "quote": "", "location": "", "reason": "No public code is available."},
  "S5_runs": {"code": "U", "quote": "", "location": "", "reason": "The paper never states how many runs were made. Each result is shown as a single envelope spectrum (Figs. 7, 9, 12). Sec. IV was checked."},
  "S5_spread_reported": {"code": "N", "quote": "The obtained envelope spectra of the original fault vibration signal are illustrated in Fig. 7.", "location": "p.8", "reason": "Results are single-run envelope spectra with no standard deviation, interval or repeated runs reported."},
  "S6_metrics": {"code": "A", "quote": "The methods used are applied to process the data, and then the fault frequency is extracted by using envelope spectrum analysis.", "location": "p.8", "reason": "No category fits well: the paper reports no accuracy, confusion matrix or F1. Evaluation is a qualitative visual comparison of normalized envelope spectra (visibility of the fault frequency and its harmonics). A, the least-rich metric category, was chosen as the closest."},
  "S7_noise_protocol": {"code": "O", "quote": "The experiment is carried out under the case of SNR = 5 dB.", "location": "p.7", "reason": "There is no train/test protocol. Noise is added to the signals that are analysed: simulated signals at SNR 20/15/10/5 dB (Sec. III-D1), and real/public signals at SNR = 5 dB (Sec. IV). The CSR filters are learned from the same noisy signal being diagnosed, so in effect learning and analysis both use noisy data. Because the method is unsupervised, this is coded O rather than B."},
  "S8_traceability": {"code": "0", "quote": "", "location": "", "reason": "No code (NO_CODE), weights, logs or raw result files are provided. The paper contains no repository or data-availability link (full text checked)."}
}
